data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Your most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in MAYS and CBK.

On October 15, MAYS disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/54187/000120677426000561/mays4703791-8k.htm).

Local Ledger is independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot. Reply "no" and I won't follow up.
